Exact savings: the 16x16 multiply accumulates its four table products through the stack, a door panel's displacement divides only its last twelve quotient bits, the per-crossing certificate is fused into the DDA loop, and the textured kernel composes rows whose step is under one texel row in 76 T instead of 104. Updates finish earlier, so living-world captures land on other accepted simulation ticks (helmet blink, animation frames). Every frame check passes.
